notes.title: Custom Music Update
notes.content:
Custom music can now be played by putting files in the Club Lipstick VR/Music folder in my documents (folder will be created after launching the game). Supported file formats are MP3 and wave.

Adjusted scene lightning.

Performance adjustments.

Examples of supported music file locations:

[list]
[*]My Documents/Club Lipstick VR/Music/

[*]My Documents/Club Lipstick VR/Music/Artist/
or
[*]My Documents/Club Lipstick VR/Music/Album/

[*]My Documents/Club Lipstick VR/Music/Artist/Album/

[*]My Documents/Club Lipstick VR/Music/Artists/Album/Disc/
[/list]

Artist and album/disc info is not required, folders can be named anything.

notes.title: HDRP Update
notes.content:
Club Lipstick VR has been given a graphical overhaul update with the high definition render pipeline.

Dancer snap bugfix, will no longer auto-snap incorrectly to invisible snaps.

Player "pockets" now properly align when in sitting mode.

Girl changeout snap bugfix, properly disables after a dancer swaps out.

notes.title: Private Room Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We have added several interactions to the private room including :

[list]
[*] New player with dancer interactions.
[*] New dancer with dancer interactions.
[*] New toy added, which adds additional dancer with dancer interactions.
[/list]

Additional features added :

[list]
[*] Dancers are now limited to a set number on the floor, and dynamically switch out. (Performance increase.)
[*] Players can manually switch out dancers by grabbing their hand and leading them to the woman's restroom.
[*] Cat ear headwear has been added and can be added to dancers.
[*] Two new dancers added.
[*] Various adjustments and bug fixes.
[/list]

Future updates currently in development :

[list]
[*] Brawler update (players will be able to start fights with other patrons, with additional surprises).
[*] Non-VR mode.
[*] Multiplayer update.
[*] Custom character importing systems.
[/list]

-TooDrunkenBrothers

notes.title: Patron Variety Update
notes.content:
Added patron variety (different shirts, pants).
Patrons will seat themselves at the bar now.

notes.title: Smoking Update
notes.content: Cigarettes can now be grabbed from ashtrays around the environment and smoked by the player.

notes.title: Drink Update
notes.content:
Drink splash color bug fix (would display null color sometimes).

Drink mixing has been activated (pouring one drink into another).

notes.title: Patron Bugfix / Bartender Update / Performance Adjustments
notes.content:
Patron pathfinding bugfix.

Bartender clothing can be interacted with outside of the private room.

Additional performance adjustments.

notes.title: Hand Physics Overhual
notes.content:
The player's hands will no longer go through walls and most objects.
Added haptics to some private room clothing interactions.
Patrons AI adjustments/bugfixes.

notes.title: Patron Update
notes.content:
Patrons now randomly choose their sitting location.
Patrons will stand, and relocate occasionally.

notes.title: Bartender Update
notes.content:
The bartender can now be brought into the private room by placing money into the tip jar on the bar.
Some collision adjustments.

notes.title: Staff Update
notes.content:
Staff can be brought into the private room by placing enough currency on their tray, or near them.
Staff texture updates.

notes.title: Animation Set Bugfix
notes.content: Fixed a bug with the animation sets.

notes.title: Haptics Update
notes.content:
Pockets bugfix, update (will only trigger if your hand is open when first reaching into your pocket).
Added haptic feedback to the pockets (will vibrate when you're reaching into your pockets).
Added haptic feedback to various objects, with more to come!

notes.title: First Content Update
notes.content:
To celebrate Club Lipstick VR's first week of release, we have updated with our first content update.

A new dancer has joined the club!

notes.title: Bartender AI Update
notes.content:
Bartender AI updated.

Private Room bugfixes (room exit bug).

notes.title: Drink Cleanup
notes.content:
Added a drink cleanup script, for empty glasses on the floor.

Updated WMR controls to use the controls sticks for movement and rotation (sticks weren't set up properly).

Various bugfixes.

notes.title: Drink Update
notes.content:
Dancers no longer spill drinks on the staff's tray.

Patrons updated, they now hold drinks properly. Also will dispose of drinks after they have finished them.

notes.title: Multi-fix update
notes.content:
Money-slinging bugfix.

Private room snap ring bugfixes (pink, other adjustments), Multiple girl interactions updated.

Splash-screen added.

WMR controls updated.

notes.title: Various Adjustment Update
notes.content:
Further sound effects update.

Money dissipation rate improved.

Dancer freezing after top removal bug removed.

Various adjustments / minor bugs fixed.

notes.title: Player Snap Update (Private Room)
notes.content: Updated player snap points (light blue) in the private room to be more reponsive.

notes.title: Dancer A.I. Update
notes.content: Dancer locking-up issue has been fixed.

notes.title: Dancer Update
notes.content: Fixed dancers lead to a private room. Now they will automatically activate the private room, once lead in.

notes.title: Windows Mixed Reality Control Update
notes.content: Controls for the Windows MR, X / A buttons are down on dpads, Y / B buttons are up on dpads.

notes.title: Vive Controls Update
notes.content: Vive controls have been adjusted again. The Y (left) / B (right) buttons can be trigger by the UP on the dpad. X (left) / A (right) buttons can be triggered by the DOWN on the dpad.

notes.title: Third Sound Patch
notes.content:
Added in additional background noises.
Private room bugfixes.

notes.title: 4th Daily Update
notes.content:
Added in ambient sounds.

Adjusted dancer A* pathfinding.

Other various minor adjusts / changes.

notes.title: Third Release Patch
notes.content:
Started adding additional sound systems.

Dancer updates.
